question:
Select the most appropriate segment to substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

The Sumo wrestler seemed to be __incapable in being tired__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"incapable"** means lacking the ability or strength to do something. (असमर्थ)

 
 
• **Example:** He is **incapable** of lying to his friends.
 
 
 
• **"Incapable of"** is the correct prepositional phrase to use when describing someone who lacks the ability to do something. (असमर्थ होना)
 
 
• **Example:** The machine is **incapable of **functioning without electricity.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Incapable from** (असमर्थ होना से): This is an incorrect phrase and is not used in English.

 
 
• **Example:** This phrase is not grammatically correct.
 
 
 
• **Incapable to** (असमर्थ होना के लिए): This is also an incorrect phrase and is not used in English.
 
 
• **Example:** This phrase is not grammatically correct.
 
 
 
• **Incapable by** (असमर्थ होना द्वारा): This is an incorrect phrase and is not used in English.
 
 
• **Example:** This phrase is not grammatically correct.
